If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English
You manage your own day well and take feedback seriously when it comes
🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.
🚀 Why doinstruct
You'll get coaching from Jiri (one of Germany's top sales trainers) alongside day-to-day feedback from an SDR lead who's genuinely among the best in the country
The SDR team has real influence on how we approach markets. You're not just running someone else's sequences
We're honest about what's working and what isn't, in both directions
400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which makes the conversation easier

About Funden: Founders think raising capital is a relationship problem. It's actually a preparation and signal problem. Funden builds the infrastructure that makes investors come to founders: a clean, investor grade deal plus a compounding public signal, instead of chasing warm intros that rarely close.

We work with a limited number of pre seed to Series B founders at a time, by application only. We'd rather tell someone we're not a fit before they apply than after. That selectivity is the backdrop for this role. You're not talking founders into something they'll regret.

You're helping serious operators decide whether an institutional grade process is worth committing to. Location: Work from anywhere. Funden operates across San Francisco, New York, and London, and this role can be based wherever you are. Compensation: Commission only, uncapped.

Warm, pre qualified inbound plus the freedom to build your own outbound pipeline. Full commission structure, ramp expectations, and average deal economics are shared transparently on the first conversation. We'd rather you have the real numbers before you invest your time than after.

About the Role: This is a full cycle sales role focused on two things: bringing in new leads and closing the inbound ones. The majority of your pipeline is warm. Founders apply through the site, self select on stage and raise size, and arrive already interested.

You'll run the interview call, pressure test the deal alongside our team, and close the founders who are genuinely a fit. Alongside that inbound engine, you'll do outbound, sourcing founders and referral relationships that match our profile, to keep the pipeline full between cohorts. You own the conversation from first call to signed engagement.

You'll turn away founders who aren't right, because a bad fit close costs us more than a missed one. This is a commission only role. There is no base salary. The trade is straightforward: uncapped earnings, warm and pre qualified inbound, a real product with real outcomes behind it, and the autonomy to run your own pipeline.

If you close, you earn, with no ceiling on how much. Your Role Responsibility:
Run discovery and qualification calls with inbound founder applicants, pressure testing narrative, stage, and readiness against our fit criteria
Close engagements with founders who are a strong fit, and confidently disqualify those who aren't
Source outbound leads: founders and referral partners such as operators, angels, and accelerators matching the pre seed to Series B profile
Own your pipeline end to end, including forecasting, follow up, and CRM hygiene
Translate a nuanced offering (audit, deal materials, and a compounding signal system) into terms a founder can act on
Feed the team real signal from the market: which objections recur, which segments convert, what founders actually respond to

Experienced in a considered, consultative B2B sale, ideally to founders, operators, or finance literate buyers
Comfortable, energized even, by a commission only structure, because you back your own ability to close
Credible in a room with founders and investors; you can hold a substantive conversation about fundraising, deal quality, and what actually moves capital
Genuinely willing to say no to a bad fit deal, and disciplined enough to protect the brand over a short term win
Self-directed: you build your own process, manage your own pipeline, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Experience in venture, startup fundraising, M&A, investment banking, or a founder facing SaaS or fintech sale

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen.

Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt.

Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser:innen. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

Dabei kommunizierst du über verschiedene Kanäle wie zum Beispiel Telefon, E-Mail oder WhatsApp, um einen effizienten Verkaufsprozess zu gewährleisten und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit von Verkäufer:innen und Händlern
Denn ohne dein Zutun würden viele Verkäufe sprichwörtlich auf der Strecke bleiben, du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Verkäufer:innen und Händlern und sorgst so kontinuierlich für hohe Verkaufsquoten

Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.
Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.
As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.
We're hiring a Business Development Representative to help build Qdrant's enterprise pipeline. You'll report directly to our Enterprise sales leaders and work side by side with them on the accounts that matter most to our growth.
This isn't a role where you'll just work a list. You'll run both inbound and outbound motions, and you'll operate strategically inside key accounts to help identify and drive expansion opportunities alongside the Enterprise team. You'll be a first line of contact for engineering and AI leaders evaluating vector search infrastructure, so a genuine curiosity about how production AI systems are built matters here.
What you will own
Report directly to Qdrant's Enterprise sales leaders and act as an extension of their account strategy.
Run outbound prospecting into named enterprise accounts, targeting engineering, AI, and data leaders building retrieval and agentic AI systems.
Qualify and progress inbound leads generated by marketing, content, and community channels.
Research target accounts to identify expansion opportunities within existing customers and new logos in strategic segments.
Work closely with Enterprise AEs to develop strategic outreach and multi-threaded account plans for key accounts.
Run discovery conversations to understand a prospect's retrieval, search, and AI infrastructure challenges.
Book qualified meetings and hand off well-scoped opportunities to the Enterprise sales team.
Build outbound workflows using tools like Claude and Common Room to research accounts, personalize outreach, and scale prospecting.
Keep Salesforce and pipeline data accurate and current, and share account and market insights back with sales, marketing, and product teams.
Hit monthly and quarterly targets for qualified pipeline generated.

Up to three years of experience in a business development, sales development, or similar quota-carrying prospecting role, ideally at a technical B2B SaaS or infrastructure company.
A track record of hitting or exceeding pipeline generation targets.
Comfort with both inbound follow-up and proactive outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to speak credibly to technical audiences.
A genuine interest in AI infrastructure, vector search, or developer tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be willing to learn the technical fundamentals.
A genuine interest in building a career in sales.
Experience with a CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.
Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity in a fast-growing company.

You have an understanding of key personas in the AI/ML space.
Familiarity with databases, search, and cloud infrastructure.
Engineering or computer science background.
A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

s.t:
Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.
High ownership and real impact.
Open-source, engineering-driven culture.
Choose your own laptop equipment.

What is Leapsome?
Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams . Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.
Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone , and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.
Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!
Your Opportunity
We're building the SDR function at Leapsome from the ground up, and you'd be the third person on the team. That's a different job than joining an established sales org. There's no thick playbook waiting for you to follow. You'll help write it: what messaging works, which accounts to prioritize, what a good week actually looks like. If you want ownership over your process instead of a script to read from, this is built for you.
Our philosophy: we're AI forward. Automations handle the repetitive parts of prospecting, so you're not spending your day on manual busywork. Your job is to test what's actually working and add the human spark; the right tone, the right timing, the read on what a real person needs to hear.
Day to day, you'll research and reach out to HR and People leaders who could genuinely benefit from Leapsome, qualify them, and hand off strong opportunities to our AEs. We measure success in pipeline generated and meetings booked, and we're transparent about the career opportunities to grow your sales profession.
We want teammates who are curious about the people they're calling, competitive about hitting their number, and motivated to build something together rather than just follow the steps someone else laid out.

Research prospects and reach out with messaging built for their specific situation, not a generic template

Build real expertise in HR tech, and know where Leapsome wins against the competition

Warum Hilti
Hilti ist ein global führendes Unternehmen in der Bauinnovation mit mehr als 34\.000 Teammitgliedern in 120 Ländern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Bauwesen zu verbessern. Deshalb liegt es uns am Herzen, zu lernen, zu wachsen und neue Wege zu finden, eine bleibende Wirkung zu erzielen.

Hier kannst Du Deine Stärken einbringen, mit einem globalen und inklusiven Team zusammenarbeiten und Dich sinnvollen Herausforderungen stellen. Bei Hilti kannst Du Deine Ideen durch zielgerichtetes Handeln, Leidenschaft und Teamwork in reale Errungenschaften und Wachstum verwandeln.
Verpflichtung zur Inklusion
Inklusion ist bei Hilti ein zentraler Aspekt unserer Arbeitsweise, unseres Führungsstils und unseres gemeinsamen Wachstums. Wir engagieren uns aktiv für Gedankenvielfalt und ein Umfeld, das für alle und überall inklusiv ist. Wir streben fortlaufend danach, dass jede Stimme gehört wird und sich jedes Teammitglied befähigt fühlt, sich einzubringen. Indem wir dieses Fundament schaffen, stärken wir unsere Teams, unsere Innovation und unsere Wirkung, um gemeinsam das Bauwesen zu verbessern.
Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt, bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz zu arbeiten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Online\-Bewerbung. Deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, CV, Zeugnisse) nehmen wir über unser Online\-Karrieretool entgegen. Frau Joèlle , HR Talent Partner, freut sich auf Dein Anschreiben und steht Dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung: [E\-Mail schreiben](<>)
Was kannst Du erwarten, wenn du Dich bei Hilti bewirbst?
\- Wir verpflichten uns, alle Bewerbungen von einem Menschen prüfen zu lassen. Auch wenn niemand unfehlbar ist, stehen wir bei allem, was wir tun, zu unserem personenzentrierten Ansatz.
\- Sobald Du Deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst Du automatische Benachrichtigungen von unserem System (ausgelöst durch unser Rekrutierungsteam).
\- Bewerbungen, die es nicht bis zum Vorstellungsgespräch mit einem einstellenden Manager schaffen, erhalten kein personalisiertes Feedback.
\- Du kannst davon ausgehen, dass Du innerhalb von 2\-3 Wochen (im Durchschnitt) von uns hörst \- unabhängig vom Ergebnis. Der gesamte Einstellungsprozess kann zwischen 5 und 6 Wochen dauern.
Wir wünschen Dir viel Erfolg in deinem Bewerbungsverfahren.

Strategic Prospecting: Identify and research high-growth organizations—from AI startups to Fortune 500 enterprises—that are struggling with Kubernetes scalability and infrastructure costs.
Technical Outreach: Craft highly personalized, technical outreach that cuts through the noise. You won’t be using "fluff"; you’ll be engaging engineers with value-driven narratives about virtualization and resource efficiency.
Pipeline Architecture: Own the top-of-funnel engine, converting inbound interest and outbound leads into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.
Multi-Channel Mastery: Orchestrate a modern sequence of touchpoints across LinkedIn, email, and phone, while engaging authentically in developer-centric spaces.
Market Intelligence: Act as a critical feedback loop for Product and Marketing by capturing the "voice of the prospect" and identifying emerging pain points in the AI and MLOps landscape.
Process Innovation: Partner with Sales Ops to constantly refine our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay) and experiment with new ways to automate the mundane so you can focus on the meaningful.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or a high-intensity customer-facing role, preferably within the DevOps, Cloud, or SaaS space.
Technical Curiosity: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be "K8s-curious." You are excited to learn the difference between a pod and a virtual cluster so you can speak with authority.
Grit & Ownership: You thrive in an early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written. You take extreme ownership of your targets and drive outcomes without needing a script.
Communication Clarity: You have a gift for distilling complex infrastructure concepts into clear, high-impact messages that spark curiosity in highly technical buyers.
AI-Native Workflow: You naturally use AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and streamline your daily workflow to stay ahead of the curve.
Cognitive Flexibility: You view "no" as data. You are quick to pivot your strategy based on feedback and market signals.

Ecosystem Familiarity: Prior exposure to the CNCF landscape, Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), or the AI/ML stack.
Social Selling: A demonstrated ability to build professional rapport and authority on LinkedIn or within technical communities.
Founding Mentality: A desire to grow into a closer (AE) or a leadership role as we scale through our next phase of growth.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Platinum-Level Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for
s.t:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

M. Dodaj, comment s'est déroulé votre premier rendez-vous ce matin ?
Ma matinée s'est très bien passée. Le premier rendez-vous consistait à présenter le SIBIR à un important propriétaire immobilier. Ce fut une rencontre agréable, au cours de laquelle j'ai réussi à susciter l'intérêt du propriétaire pour SIBIR et à le convaincre de notre offre.
Quel rôle jouez-vous en tant que responsable régional des ventes chez SIBIR ?
En tant que responsable régional des ventes, je suis chargé de l'accompagnement complet et du soutien des clients professionnels et privés dans la région de Zurich et de la Suisse centrale.

Mon domaine de responsabilité ne se limite pas seulement à l'entretien des relations clients existantes, mais inclut également la tâche cruciale d'acquérir de nouveaux clients dans ma zone de compétence.

Cette double mission exige une approche globale afin de garantir que tant les clients actuels que potentiels bénéficient du meilleur service et conseil possible.
Avec quels départements travaillez-vous particulièrement en étroite collaboration ?
Dans mon travail quotidien, je collabore étroitement avec la planification du service et le service commercial interne. L'échange régulier avec ces départements est essentiel pour assurer un traitement sans accroc.

Tant dans la planification que dans le service commercial interne, des collègues expérimentés et professionnels travaillent ensemble pour offrir un service optimal à nos clients et répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Cette coopération étroite permet une coordination efficace des processus et garantit que nous pouvons répondre de manière flexible aux besoins de nos clients.
Quelles tendances observez-vous dans les produits SIBIR ?
Les produits SIBIR mettent clairement en avant les tendances de la Swissness, de l'élégance ainsi que d'un design simple et épuré. Ces éléments représentent une promesse de qualité. La focalisation sur la simplicité et l'épuration souligne non seulement la convivialité des produits, mais reflète également un design intemporel.

Ces tendances visent à garantir que les produits SIBIR ne soient pas seulement fonctionnels, mais aussi esthétiquement attrayants et en accord avec les normes élevées de la tradition de fabrication suisse.
Et dans le domaine du service toutes marques ?
Dans l'évolution actuelle du service toutes marques, des tendances claires se dégagent. Un souhait croissant des clients est de recevoir tous les services regroupés et fournis par un seul interlocuteur. La nécessité d'avoir un point de contact unique pour divers besoins prend de plus en plus d'importance.

Il est notable que le prix n'est souvent plus au centre des préoccupations. Les clients accordent plutôt une importance accrue à un traitement professionnel et efficace de leurs demandes, ce qui est considéré comme une valeur ajoutée.

Cela illustre un déplacement des considérations purement financières vers un accent renforcé sur la qualité globale du service et la simplicité du traitement.
Comment percevez-vous vos clients, qu'ils soient administrations ou particuliers ?
Mes expériences avec mes clients, qu'il s'agisse d'administrations ou de particuliers, sont globalement positives. Je suis heureux de pouvoir dire que j'entretiens des relations très agréables avec nos clients chez SIBIR.

La collaboration avec les administrations et les particuliers se déroule de manière positive, et j'apprécie la possibilité de contribuer à leur satisfaction. Je me réjouis de continuer à soutenir nos clients avec enthousiasme à l'avenir et de poursuivre ces expériences positives de collaboration.
Cela nécessite certainement des mesures de vente individuelles. Les développez-vous seul ?
Nous disposons de cadres très expérimentés qui nous soutiennent à un niveau élevé. Lors du développement des mesures de vente, il est toutefois important de noter que chaque client a des besoins différents. Il est donc indispensable d'être flexible et d'utiliser les mesures de vente appropriées au bon moment. Cela exige de chaque membre de l'équipe de la sensibilité et de la flexibilité.
Concernant la durabilité : comment pourrait-on économiser davantage de CO2 ?
Spécialement dans le contexte des appareils ménagers, je souhaite souligner les points suivants : prolongation de la durée de vie des appareils : la garantie des pièces détachées de SIBIR suit déjà une voie très positive avec nos clients. Pas moins de 70 % de tous les appareils sont réparés et non remplacés.

En favorisant une durée de vie plus longue et en garantissant la disponibilité des pièces détachées, nous contribuons activement à réduire l'empreinte écologique et à minimiser les émissions de CO2.

Ces approches durables sont non seulement en accord avec les objectifs environnementaux, mais démontrent également notre engagement commun pour un avenir respectueux des ressources.
La réparation des machines cassées a-t-elle aujourd'hui une plus grande importance ?
Absolument. Cette évolution est perceptible pour moi personnellement et je la perçois de manière positive. Une tendance claire se manifeste dans la préférence de nos clients pour les réparations plutôt que pour l'achat immédiat d'un nouvel appareil.

Cela souligne non seulement une conscience environnementale accrue, mais reflète également une valorisation croissante des pratiques durables. L'importance accrue accordée à la réparation des machines cassées se reflète donc non seulement dans ma perception personnelle, mais est également clairement soulignée par les préférences de notre clientèle.
Quel était votre métier de rêve enfant ?
Enfant, mon métier de rêve était policier. Mais au fil du temps, j'ai développé un fort intérêt pour une activité dans la vente. J'ai finalement pu réaliser ce rêve chez SIBIR.

s.h: CONSEILLER STYLE BOUTIQUE - ZEGNA AÉROPORT DE ZURICH
s.t:
Ce qui fait vous, fait Zegna
L-héritage de Zegna n-existerait pas sans les compétences uniques de chaque personne de notre équipe ; les artisans, maîtres, designers et acteurs. Chacun contribue.
En tant que Conseiller Style Boutique Zegna, vous apportez la touche humaine à l-expérience de luxe. Vous êtes notre ambassadeur, partageant à la fois notre riche héritage et nos collections, et offrant un service aussi personnel qu-exceptionnel, façonnant leur perception de notre marque et assurant notre croissance continue et notre héritage.
Ce qui compose votre journée
Plongez dans un environnement de travail pratique et intellectuel où chaque défi et opportunité vous aide à réaliser votre plein potentiel.
Vous apprendrez les histoires derrière la marque Zegna, ses produits et son savoir-faire, les utilisant pour engager authentiquement les clients en partageant notre offre et en construisant des relations durables avec eux afin qu-ils se sentent une partie précieuse du monde Zegna.
Vous et vos collègues êtes responsables d-atteindre les objectifs de vente de votre boutique, d-exécuter les plans fournis par votre responsable de boutique, ainsi que d-utiliser votre propre initiative pour suggérer des stratégies alternatives.
Vous êtes responsable de veiller à ce que l-environnement de la boutique soit toujours à la hauteur des attentes de nos clients et bien organisé. Pour cela, vous serez impliqué dans le merchandising visuel, l-emballage, la gestion du stock, l-inventaire, la caisse et les rapports.
Ce qui fait vous, fait notre équipe
Lorsque vous rejoignez Zegna, vous intégrez une équipe, travaillant ensemble pour façonner l-avenir de notre entreprise. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous avez une passion pour le style que vous emportez partout, mélangeant looks décontractés et luxueux pour s-adapter à votre style de vie actif.

Vous êtes curieux par nature, aventurier et intéressé par la technologie. Vous vous connectez à l-esprit innovant derrière la marque Zegna et savez comment le rendre pertinent et intéressant lorsque vous le partagez avec les autres.
Ce qui fait vous, fait notre héritage
Le groupe Ermenegildo Zegna est fondé sur une fière histoire d-artisanat et de qualité remontant à 1910, avec une vision de créer éthiquement les plus beaux textiles du monde. Zegna s-est depuis étendu au prêt-à-porter, devenant l-une des entreprises familiales italiennes les plus prospères et une marque mondiale de style de vie de luxe.

As a BDR at Ben, you will be a cornerstone of our sales team and building our outbound sales model. You will work closely with the Founders and both our Growth and Customer Success teams to grow the sales pipeline and develop best practices that will ensure our long-term scalability. You'll work towards weekly and monthly targets and evaluate different approaches for efficiency and effectiveness to find the best strategic sales processes.
This is a perfect opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing a career in sales, and who later down the line, may want to lead and grow our BDR function, move into field sales, or even join our customer success team supporting clients. It really is the beginning for us, so it's an exciting time to join!
Things you will be working on…
Research the market: utilise prospecting and research tools to identify, target and qualify relevant prospective clients within Ben's ideal customer profile
Engage new customers: execute outbound prospecting campaigns in coordination with the Growth team (emails, calls, video-mails, social selling) to generate leads in our target markets
Develop new customers: understand customer needs to gather key prospect information, generate interest and bring high-quality prospects into the sales pipeline
Deliver results: pursue both individual and team goals and work towards monthly targets and KPIs
Contribute to the foundations of a growing world-class sales team: Bring your sales skill set to the table and help us create the foundations for a high performing team
You will love this role if you have…
Extremely organised - you’ll be owning and managing your sales pipeline and KPIs, so it’s crucial you can prioritise your work and manage your time effectively
Highly motivated by targets - you’ll have a strong drive to succeed and hit your weekly and monthly KPIs
Passionate about sales - you’ll genuinely care about helping people find the right solution, and you’ll have a proactive approach to expanding your knowledge of our product offering and our market
Knowledge of systems would be a bonus - it would be great if you have working knowledge of Hubspot, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, but this isn’t a deal breaker!
Excellent verbal and written English is essential - you’ll be communicating with our potential customers on a daily basis
Drive & motivation - you’ll be a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, enjoys a rapid pace and wants to make a difference
AI-literate - you're comfortable using AI tools to speed up manual work and sharpen your research and prospecting, and you're keen to find smarter ways of working
You will not love this role if you….
Aren’t comfortable working in a fast paced environment
Are not ready to own your own results and be held accountable
Like maintaining the status-quo and aren’t willing to think outside the box
Like a lot of structure and processes, we are a start-up and are still working things out and we don’t always know what’s next
Are not comfortable with ambiguity, we will give you guidance but sometimes you have to work things out
Wait for others to step up, or to be told what to do. We are a high-performance and high-reward work place and are looking for people who are proactive

At Ultralytics , we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models . If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.
🤝 Senior Business Development Representative

s.h: 🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
s.t:
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.
⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics , we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading YOLO models , we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.
Following our $30M Series A round , we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.
We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

This isn't an SDR role. It's an apprenticeship designed to turn you into an elite seller.
We don't hire people to book meetings and disappear. We hire Senior BDR who own markets, build playbooks, and learn to close deals working shoulder-to-shoulder with experienced sellers. You'll own two strategic vertical markets end-to-end — research the territory, identify key accounts, build relationships, generate pipeline, and develop the repeatable motion that makes those verticals ours.
You'll be paired 1:1 with an Enterprise Account Executive who'll teach you how complex sales cycles actually move. This is for people who want to build something, own something, and become exceptional at commercial work.

De l-introduction du prêt-à-porter, alors que les vêtements sur mesure étaient encore la norme, à la popularisation des minijupes dans les années 60, en passant par l-introduction du bikini Com-Bi dans les années 70, le coton biologique au début des années 2000, jusqu-au premier vêtement certifié Cradle-to-Cradle Or en 2017 - nous avons toujours évolué avec notre temps et rendu la mode élégante et de qualité accessible à tous.

Et si C&A et le monde qui nous entoure ont changé au fil des décennies, une chose est restée constante : notre engagement à offrir une mode durable et de qualité pour toute la famille.
Nous souhaitons pour l-avenir une industrie de la mode plus innovante et durable ; une industrie qui se dirige vers un avenir circulaire et favorise un cycle d-utilisation, de réutilisation et de renaissance des vêtements.
En Suisse, C&A est présent avec plus de 90 magasins et emploie plus de 1 300 collaborateurs.

* Apparence visuelle du magasin
* Conception des vitrines selon les directives centrales
* Mise en œuvre d-une présentation optimale des marchandises en étroite collaboration avec le responsable du magasin et l-équipe de vente
* Ambassadeur de notre marque

* Passion pour la mode et les personnes

Thermorezo à Aigle : feu vert pour la liaison entre Satom SA et la STEP
L-expansion à Aigle du chauffage à distance, appelé « Thermorezo », marque un tournant dans la stratégie énergétique et la décarbonation du Chablais.

Une étape importante du déploiement en direction d-Aigle a été franchie avec le feu vert octroyé par les cantons de Vaud et du Valais pour la construction du tronçon reliant l-usine de valorisation thermique des déchets de Satom SA à la STEP d-Aigle.

Parallèlement à la pose des conduites du chauffage à distance en cours en ville d-Aigle, la construction de l-épine dorsale du Thermorezo va pouvoir commencer au début 2025.
Après avoir couvert une grande part des besoins en chaleur sur les communes de Monthey et de Collombey-Muraz, le Thermorezo poursuit son évolution d-Aigle via le CAD Nord, avant de se diriger vers la partie sud du Chablais.

Un pas décisif vient d-être franchi cet automne pour la liaison aiglonne par l-octroi des autorisations des cantons de Vaud et du Valais. Le développement du Thermorezo s-inscrit dans un projet ambitieux de production de chaleur générée par la valorisation thermique des déchets.
Des avancées réjouissantes
Pour rappel, deux chantiers parallèles ont été lancés pour le déploiement du CAD Nord dans la commune d-Aigle. D-une part, la pose des conduites en ville est en cours depuis septembre 2023, conformément à une convention établie entre la municipalité d-Aigle et Satom SA. D-autre part, la construction de l-épine dorsale en direction d-Aigle est en cours de réalisation.
Déposée auprès des cantons de Vaud et du Valais en juillet 2023, la mise à l-enquête de ce tronçon de six kilomètres reliant l-usine Satom SA et la STEP AERA (Association intercommunale pour l-épuration des eaux usées de la région d-Aigle) a obtenu récemment le feu vert définitif des autorités. Les permis de construire octroyés, Satom SA est en mesure de préciser la suite du calendrier des travaux. Ceux-ci se dérouleront à partir de 2025 sur les deux rives du Rhône :
Chantiers et synergies
Le tracé nécessite le passage en souterrain de canaux latéraux, du Rhône et de l-autoroute. Une phase complexe se déroulera entre le printemps 2025 et l-automne 2026 avec le creusement d-une galerie sous le fleuve grâce à un micro-tunnelier. Rien que cette opération est devisée à 4 millions de francs. Romande Energie profitera de cet ouvrage pour y faire passer des lignes électriques moyenne tension.
Satom SA précise qu-elle n'aura pas besoin de plus de déchets à valoriser pour alimenter en énergie son réseau de chauffage thermique dans la plaine du Chablais. À travers ses différents projets de renouvellement d-installations, des améliorations significatives au niveau de la récupération d-énergie thermique et d-efficience énergétique seront apportées.

Toute l-énergie thermique récupérée sera injectée dans le Thermorezo à l-échelle du Chablais et le complément encore disponible sous forme de vapeur via l-Ecotube au profit du site chimique voisin.
Le raccordement à la STEP AERA est un atout important. Il se déroule en coordination avec le projet de construction de la nouvelle station d-épuration régionale. L-énergie contenue dans les eaux des bassins pourra à terme être récupérée en fin de station par des pompes à chaleur et injectée dans le Thermorezo. Cette centrale d-appoint permettra de renforcer la fiabilité du réseau avec un apport supplémentaire d-énergie décarbonée.
Vers la fin des énergies fossiles
Le déploiement du CAD Nord sur Aigle, représentant un investissement total de 150 millions de francs, est un défi technique majeur, mais aussi une promesse d-avenir pour toute la région. Ce projet permettra de réduire la dépendance aux énergies fossiles et de contribuer activement à la protection de l-environnement.

Le Thermorezo fournira deux tiers des besoins en énergie de la ville et réduira de 70 % ses émissions de CO2 (-16-000 tonnes par an). À ce jour, environ 50 contrats ont déjà été signés. À terme, le CAD permettra de mettre définitivement à la retraite 800 cheminées alimentées par des énergies fossiles en ville d-Aigle.
La Municipalité d-Aigle et Satom SA se félicitent de cette étape concrète de la mise en œuvre de la transition énergétique dans la commune et dans la région, avec le soutien actif des cantons.
Calendrier prévisionnel
Fin 2024 : Autorisation de construire délivrée pour la liaison Satom SA - STEP AERA
Hiver 2024 - 2025 : Début des travaux sur l-épine dorsale entre Satom SA et la STEP d-Aigle
Printemps 2025 - automne 2026 : Traversée du Rhône à Illarsaz
Hiver 2026 - 2027 : Alimentation des premiers bâtiments à Aigle par les rejets de chaleur de l-UVTD (Usine de Valorisation Thermique des Déchets)

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
With 70,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.
We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.
This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.
You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.
This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.
What You'll Be Doing
Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.
Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.
Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.
This Role Is For You If
You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results
You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new
You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort
You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure
You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates
You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared
Our Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.
First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)
One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)
Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side
This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Du weißt, wie man ein Gespräch führt, das wirklich zählt. Kein reines Skript-Abarbeiten, keine Kaltakquise, kein Fließband- oder CallCenter-Vertrieb, sondern echte Beratung mit Menschen, die sich aktiv mit Börse und finanzieller Unabhängigkeit beschäftigen. Und wenn der Moment kommt, führst Du klar und souverän zum Abschluss.
Was Dich hier von anderen Positionen unterscheidet: Du bekommst Leads, die die Akademie bereits kennen. und saubere Vorbereitung durch unsere Junior Sales Manager:innen. Du bekommst Struktur, Training und Feedback. Und Du wirst für Deine Leistung so vergütet, dass sich Einsatz direkt auszahlt.
Als Tele-Sales Executive (m/w/d) wirst Du entweder in unserem modernen Office in Zwickau, Dubai oder 100 % remote (Wohnort in Deutschland erforderlich) tätig.

Warme Leads, keine Kaltakquise: Du führst Gespräche mit Menschen, die Jens Rabe und die Academy bereits kennen und die im Prozess bereits sauber vorbereitet und qualifiziert wurden: keine Kaltakquise.
Bedarfsklärung und Beratung: Du hörst zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst, wo jemand steht, fachlich und emotional. Du erklärst klar und ohne Druck, wie eine Zusammenarbeit mit der Academy aussieht.
Abschlussstärke mit Empathie: Wenn jemand zögert, nimmst Du Unsicherheit, ruhig, konkret, auf Augenhöhe. Wenn jemand bereit ist, führst Du mit Struktur und Klarheit zum Abschluss.
Proaktive Nachverfolgung: Du hältst Deine Pipeline lebendig, gehst aktiv auf Interessenten zu und gibst regelmäßig Rückmeldung ins Team.
Saubere Dokumentation: Du hältst Gesprächsverläufe nachvollziehbar fest, damit nichts verloren geht und das Team nahtlos anknüpfen kann.
Das hier ist kein Callcenter und auch kein Verkauf am Fließband.
Sondern strukturierte, ehrliche Beratung auf Augenhöhe.
Gehalt Sales Management: 5-stelliger Verdienst, bestehend aus einem fairen Fixum und leistungsbezogener Provision, möglich
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sowie leistungsorientierte Vergütung in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.
Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Strukturierte Einarbeitung (2–4 Monate): Kein Ins-kalte-Wasser-schmeißen. Du bekommst eine vollumfängliche, auf Deinen Stand zugeschnittene Vertriebsschulung, praxisnah und sofort anwendbar.
Vergütung, die sich lohnt: Faires Fixum plus leistungsorientierte Provision. Wer Leistung bringt, verdient entsprechend. Ein 5-stelliger Monatsverdienst ist nach abgeschlossener Einarbeitung realistisch (aktuelle Abschlussraten liegen zwischen 70-80%).
Flexibler Arbeitsort: Modernes Office in Zwickau oder Dubai oder 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Du entscheidest.
20 Jahre Marktpräsenz: Kein Start-up-Risiko. Die Jens Rabe Academy ist eine der bekanntesten Adressen im deutschen Finanzbildungsmarkt, mit stabiler Nachfrage und einer loyalen Community.
Kontinuierliches Training & Entwicklung: Du wirst intern weitergeschult, laufend. Zusätzlich 1.000 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr für externe Impulse.
Events & Netzwerk: Regelmäßige Teilnahme an Messen, Kongressen und Live-Events – direkter Zugang zu Top-Speakern der Branche.
27 + 2 Tage Urlaub sowie weitere Benefits: Lunch-Zuschuss, vor Ort frisches Obst, Kaffee und ein Team, das kollegial und leistungsorientiert zugleich ist.

Erfahrung im Telefon- oder Online-Vertrieb: Du weißt, wie Gespräche laufen, und hast ein Gespür dafür, wann und wie man abschließt.
Nachweisliche Ergebnisse im Führen von Abschluss-, bzw. Closing-Gesprächen: Du weißt, welche Ergebnisse zählen und kannst bisherige Erfolg klar benennen.
Interesse an Finanzen, Börse oder persönlicher Entwicklung: Du verkaufst überzeugender, wenn Du das Thema verstehst und selbst spannend findest.
Kommunikationsstärke und Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst Deinen Arbeitstag eigenverantwortlich, hältst Deine Pipeline im Blick und bist zuverlässig.
Lernbereitschaft: Du nimmst Feedback an, willst besser werden und siehst Training nicht als Pflicht, sondern als echte Investition in Dich (und nein, damit meinen wir kein finanzielles Invest).

Éprouvée depuis 1945 et présente en Suisse depuis 1962, Würth AG offre des solutions sur mesure visant à faciliter le quotidien de ses partenaires.

**À propos de DiisTee & de ta mission**
Nous sommes DiisTee, une jeune start-up suisse en plein essor qui révolutionne le marché de la gastronomie avec un concentré de thé glacé innovant et authentique. Notre produit séduit les restaurateurs parce qu'il a un goût fantastique, qu'il est extrêmement simple à servir et qu'il génère des marges hautement rentables pour l'établissement. En Suisse alémanique, nous nous sommes déjà imposés comme une valeur sûre - nous passons maintenant à la vitesse supérieure en Romandie.
Nous ne cherchons pas des « rats de bureau », mais une personnalité sociable dotée d'un véritable instinct « street-smart ». Tu construiras notre marché en Suisse romande de manière proactive. Notre promesse : si tu as la faim et la volonté d'y arriver, nous ferons de toi une véritable « machine de vente » sur le terrain de la gastronomie.
**Ta mission sur le terrain**
**Développement de relations sur le terrain :** Tu es chaque semaine sur les routes de Romandie.

Tu ouvres des portes, gagnes la confiance des gérants, chefs de bar et équipes de service, et t'établis comme un partenaire d'égal à égal.**Suivi commercial systématique :** Avec une discipline de fer dans le suivi (follow-up), tu restes accrocheur et sympathique jusqu'à ce que notre thé glacé figure sur la carte et que les réassorts rentrent.**Liberté & autonomie :** Tu gères tes tournées en 100% télétravail de manière totalement autonome.

Nous te mesurons à tes succès mesurables sur le terrain, et non au temps passé devant ton écran.**Fast-Track en équipe :** Grâce à nos réunions d'équipe hebdomadaires et à un coaching intensif, tu seras complètement opérationnel sur le terrain et sur la voie du succès en l'espace de 90 jours.
**Ce que tu apportes**
**Dynamisme & expérience :** Tu as déjà une expérience pratique dans la vente B2B ou un solide bagage opérationnel dans la gastronomie/hôtellerie (service ou bar) et tu brûles d'envie de te lancer dans la vente.**Réseau (Atout) :** Idéalement, tu disposeras déjà de premiers contacts dans la scène gastronomique romande - ce n'est pas obligatoire, mais c'est un net avantage.**Facteur de confiance :** Tu gagnes la sympathie des gens en quelques secondes, tu dégages de l'authenticité et tu sais parfaitement naviguer entre la décontraction avec les clients et le professionnalisme requis.**Aptitude numérique :** Tu te déplaces avec aisance sur ordinateur portable et smartphone.

Les systèmes basés sur le cloud (CRM/ERP) te sont familiers.**Langue & région :** Tu es ancré dans la culture romande (langue maternelle française). Tu habites idéalement dans la région de Lausanne / arc lémanique avec de bonnes connexions.

Pour la collaboration avec notre équipe, une bonne maîtrise de l'allemand est essentielle.**Mobilité :** Tu possèdes un permis de conduire de catégorie B valide et tu te réjouis des déplacements quotidiens.**Potentiel de leadership :** Tu as l'ambition de progresser.

Nous recherchons quelqu'un que nous souhaitons encourager activement - avec la perspective claire d'assumer à l'avenir des responsabilités et de manager des collaborateurs.
**Ce que nous t'offrons**

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:
Customer First : We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality : True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design : We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal : Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.
If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

Leverage AI and technology tools to scale prospecting efforts; bring ideas and test new approaches to improve outreach efficiency and conversion rates
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics to effectively position Quince against alternatives

Proficiency in CRM software and sales tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent)
Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to personalize outreach

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

s.h: We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work
s.t:
Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Flexible working hours.
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.
A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.
25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.
An employee equity incentive scheme.
Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.
Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.
Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

A learning and development budget for everyone.
Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

About LiveKit
LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.
Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.
This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.
You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.

Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.
Partner tightly with enterprise AEs on account strategy you'll co-own named accounts, align on entry points, and run coordinated multi-threaded plays to break into large organizations
Research target accounts to craft highly personalized, technically credible outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone
Book discovery calls and product demos for enterprise AEs; provide full context so they walk in sharp and prepared
Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion
Surface market intelligence back to the product and GTM teams as you're often the first to hear what buyers care about
Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

1–3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company
Genuine curiosity about technology; you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold an intelligent conversation about why a company might choose a managed WebRTC platform over a self-hosted stack
Strong written communication - you know the difference between an email that gets deleted and one that gets a reply
Experience with sales engagement tools and Salesforce
Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
Comfort working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written and flexibility is required

Background selling to engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML teams
Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communications, or WebRTC concepts
Experience at an open-source company with a PLG motion - you understand what it means when a developer has been building with your product for 6 months before the first sales conversation
Experience using AI tools to accelerate prospecting and personalization at scale
Why LiveKit
Enormous market. Real-time AI is becoming a requirement for nearly every enterprise application. We're the infrastructure layer, and we're well ahead of the field.
Incredible developer traction. Our sales team doesn't cold-call strangers they engage with a community that already loves the product.
Technical credibility. You'll sell something that engineers respect. That matters if you care about representing products you believe in.
Trajectory. This is a ground-floor opportunity on an enterprise sales team at a company with serious investor backing, strong revenue growth, and the reference customers to close big deals.
Our Commitment to You
Competitive comp: Base + uncapped commission + equity. We want SDRs who want to win.
An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

Flexible vacation policy

**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.
Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions : c'est l'une de nos valeurs - et c'est exactement ce que nous attendons de notre développement commercial. Ne pas attendre que le marché vienne à nous - le conquérir activement.
*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.
* Conclure : calculer les prix, établir les offres - même les plus complexes - et remporter la commande.
*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.
* Gérer votre activité à l'aide d'indicateurs clés : rendez-vous qualifiés, taux de conclusion, pipeline. Vous les connaissez, les suivez et en assumez la responsabilité.
*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.
* Vous êtes bilingue allemand - français, ou avez l'allemand comme langue maternelle avec d'excellentes connaissances en français (oral et écrit).
* Les objectifs basés sur les chiffres ne vous font pas peur : vous êtes habitué(e) à travailler avec des KPIs, un CRM et des rapports réguliers - et vous y voyez un outil, pas une contrainte.
* La vente industrielle est votre univers : vous connaissez les longs cycles de décision, les multiples interlocuteurs et les défis techniques - et savez comment tenir la distance du premier contact à la signature du contrat.
* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.
*Ces cinq points sont indispensables. Sans eux, nous ne pourrons malheureusement pas prendre en compte votre candidature.*
Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.
**Vos compétences**
* Vous aimez ouvrir des portes - le premier contact vous stimule plutôt que de vous freiner.
* Résilience et endurance : un refus est pour vous une information, pas un échec - et un cycle de vente de dix-huit mois ne vous effraie pas.
* Orientation résultats : vous vous fixez des objectifs ambitieux et faites spontanément rapport de leur avancement.
* Organisation et suivi rigoureux : rien ne se perd, rien ne reste en suspens.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, tant avec les techniciens qu'avec les acheteurs. Sensibilité aux questions environnementales : vous vendez une solution utile - et vous y croyez.
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.
* La possibilité de télétravail partiel.
* Le soutien de nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour ainsi que d'équipes fières de leur travail.
* Un salaire correspondant à votre expérience sur la base de 13 mois, ainsi que des prestations sociales attractives.
**Votre candidature**
Vous aimez conquérir de nouveaux marchés et construire un pipeline qui tient ses promesses ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre talent commercial au service d'une entreprise engagée pour l'environnement ?

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.

Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.

Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
